limitations: Standalone benchmark process footprint excludes unowned Core ML/ANE service memory; not a system-wide RAM measurement.
Final timing includes input packing, inference and CGImage assembly; PNG encoding is excluded. Loading is reported separately.
Core ML plans are anticipated placement, not hardware counters. All new runtime configurations exclude GPU.
Image quality is measured against the starting FP16 output; native tensor gates separately compare with official CPU FP32 weights.
SSIM is the mean over non-overlapping 8x8 luma windows, not Gaussian 11x11 SSIM.
W8A8 calibration uses three NASA-image views for the final trials; this is a bounded experiment, not a comprehensive quantization study.
M4 hardware and reliable power/energy counters were unavailable.

Starting x4 FP16 was remeasured with the same explicit small warm-up and two runs as W8A8; previous measurements remain under measurementHistory. Optimized FP16 rows retain their earlier measurements.
